en.p: For the two sets $A=\{2,\,3,\,4\}$ and $B=\{2,\,3\}$, the following trial is performed.

box: Choose one of the 8 subsets of set $A$ at random,
and choose one of the 4 subsets of set $B$ at random.
Record the number of elements in the intersection of the two chosen sets.

en.p: This trial is repeated 15360 times. When the probability that the recorded number is $1$ at least 5880 times, obtained using the standard normal table below, is $k$, find the value of $1000\times k$. [4 points]
